segments.t: 现在是波特兰菩提树庭院客栈星期六的清晨。就在几个小时前，格雷厄姆刚从地下室搬出一个布满灰尘的雪松木箱，上面印着九号房间的印记。格雷厄姆正转动着小巧的黄铜钥匙，汉娜和亚瑟则趴在接待台前仔细看着。请先听一遍完整的场景。
Turn the small key slowly, Graham. My heart is beating fast!
Relax, boss. A brass lock from the cellar never breaks.
It clicked! Lift the wooden lid, Graham!
Inside we have... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.
Read the top of that folded blue paper! Where are my glasses?
Still on your forehead, Arthur, right where you left them last night.
Aha! Look here: 'First Floor — Room Nine — Garden Sunroom'!
Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the first floor?!
Look at the arrow behind the back hallway bookcase.
That heavy wooden bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!
Then behind those old books, there is a ninth door!
Drink one sip of coffee first. Then we move the books.
现在我们来一步步回顾这个场景。
Turn the small key slowly, Graham. My heart is beating fast!
‘慢慢转动这把小钥匙，格雷厄姆。我的心跳得好快！’为了表达此时此刻我们能感受到的心跳，这里使用了进行时
is beating fast
其中 fast 直接作为副词使用，没有加任何后缀。
Relax, boss. A brass lock from the cellar never breaks.
‘放轻松，老板。地下室的黄铜锁是永远不会坏的。’使用
never breaks
只需把 never 放在现在时动词前面，不需要双重否定。
It clicked! Lift the wooden lid, Graham!
‘咔嚓响了！把木盖子打开，格雷厄姆！’这个金属声直接用过去式表达动作
It clicked!
而 lid 可以指代任何箱子、茶壶或罐子的盖子。
Inside we have... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.
‘里面有……一把大门钥匙，一张蓝色的平面图，还有明信片。’一个名词直接放在另一个名词前面起修饰作用：
door key
表示这是一把什么类型的钥匙，而不需要使用介词。
Read the top of that folded blue paper! Where are my glasses?
‘读读那张折叠的蓝纸上面的字！我的眼镜在哪儿？’因为眼镜有两个镜片，所以
Where are my glasses?
总是需要用复数形式。
Still on your forehead, Arthur, right where you left them last night.
‘还在你的额头上呢，亚瑟，就在你昨晚放它们的地方。’亚瑟一贯的健忘给我们留下了这个非常精确的短语
right where
在这里 right 的意思是‘恰好，正好’。
Aha! Look here: 'First Floor — Room Nine — Garden Sunroom'!
‘啊哈！看看这里：一楼 — 九号房间 — 花园日光室。’在美国，first floor 指的是一楼（即地面层），而
Sunroom'
把 sun（太阳）和 room（房间）结合起来，指代一个玻璃阳光房。
Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the first floor?!
‘等等，我们一楼有一个阳光充足的花园日光室！？’在表达惊讶和难以置信时，疑问句保持和陈述句相同的语序，只是在句末升高语调。
Look at the arrow behind the back hallway bookcase.
‘看看后走廊书架后面的那个箭头。’在这个词中，三个部分从大到小依次连接
back hallway bookcase
其中 bookcase 是由 book（书）和 case（框架、套子）组成的。
That heavy wooden bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!
‘那个沉重的木书架靠在那面墙上已经二十年了！’对于一件多年来一直靠在同一个地方的家具来说，这听起来非常自然
has stood against
这里使用了 stand 的不规则分词 stood。
Then behind those old books, there is a ninth door!
‘那么那些旧书后面有一扇第九道门！’在句首，then 连接了逻辑结论，而
ninth door
nine 在加上 th 之前去掉了不发音的 e。
Drink one sip of coffee first. Then we move the books.
‘先喝一小口咖啡。然后我们去搬那些书。’对于小剂量的饮料，我们说
one sip of coffee
使用 sip 表示一小口。让我们以正常语速再听一遍整个场景。
Turn the small key slowly, Graham. My heart is beating fast!
Relax, boss. A brass lock from the cellar never breaks.
It clicked! Lift the wooden lid, Graham!
Inside we have... one big door key, a blue plan, and postcards.
Read the top of that folded blue paper! Where are my glasses?
Still on your forehead, Arthur, right where you left them last night.
Aha! Look here: 'First Floor — Room Nine — Garden Sunroom'!
Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the first floor?!
Look at the arrow behind the back hallway bookcase.
That heavy wooden bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!
Then behind those old books, there is a ninth door!
Drink one sip of coffee first. Then we move the books.
在雪松木箱里有一把大门钥匙和一张蓝色的平面图，它直接指向后走廊书架的后面。如果有些词过得太快也没关系；它们马上就会再次出现。回头见。
See you soon!
